propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed the producer differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes, the dispatch arm _run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch, and reconcile_helpers.route_inbound_probe.

Semantic search and string grep both confirm no production call site outside the port surface exists; two stale docstrings falsely claim inbound_probe.py is dynamically loaded, but no lazy_load or import_module call to it exists.
The port's original purpose (same-pass re-creation of confirmed-deleted issues) is ruled out by an earlier operator decision, making re-homing to binding_walk unsafe and unnecessary.

Deletion is safe and behavior-neutral because the outbound probe chain (_apply_outbound_probe, MutationKind.probe under Direction.outbound) remains untouched and live; only the inbound (inbound, probe) chain is dormant.

Deletion requires changes across 26 files: 3 source files deleted outright, 8 source files edited to drop the port, 3 test files deleted, and 7 test files edited; all files that name the deleted units as invariants must be updated.
